title: Deep Learning-Driven Inverse Design of Doherty Power Amplifiers Using Pixelated Combiners and Dual-State Impedance Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2606.18395v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The output combiner of a Doherty power amplifier (PA) integrates load modulation, impedance matching, and phase compensation within a single network, making its design and synthesis highly challenging. In this paper, we propose a three-port Doherty combiner design methodology that combines deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs), pixelated layout representations, and genetic algorithms (GA) with dual-state impedance synthesis to address both peak and back-off power conditions. As a proof of concept, two GaN HEMT Doherty PA prototypes incorporating three-port pixelated combiners are designed and fabricated. Both prototypes achieve a measured saturated output power exceeding 44.2 dBm with peak drain efficiency above 71.2% within 2.6-2.8 GHz. Furthermore, a drain efficiency as high as 64% is measured at the 6-dB back-off level. After applying digital predistortion, each prototype achieves an adjacent channel leakage ratio (ACLR)

translated_title: 基于深度学习的像素化合成器和双状态阻抗合成Doherty功率放大器逆向设计
translated_abstract: Doherty功率放大器（PA）的输出合成器将负载调制、阻抗匹配和相位补偿集成在单一网络中，使其设计和合成极具挑战性。本文提出了一种三端口Doherty合成器设计方法，结合深度卷积神经网络（CNNs）、像素化布局表示和遗传算法（GA）与双状态阻抗合成，以同时满足峰值和回退功率条件。作为概念验证，设计并制造了两款采用三端口像素化合成器的GaN HEMT Doherty PA原型。两款原型在2.6-2.8 GHz频段内实现了超过44.2 dBm的饱和输出功率，峰值漏极效率高于71.2%。此外，在6-dB回退水平下测得的漏极效率高达64%。应用数字预失真后，每个原型实现了相邻信道泄漏比（ACLR）...
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合深度CNN、像素化布局和遗传算法的三端口Doherty合成器设计方法，实现了高效、高功率的GaN HEMT PA原型，在峰值和回退条件下均表现出色。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a three-port Doherty combiner design method combining deep CNNs, pixelated layouts, and genetic algorithms with dual-state impedance synthesis, achieving high-efficiency, high-power GaN HEMT PA prototypes with excellent performance at both peak and back-off conditions.
